title: Builder misread a criterion
hard: The implementation computes the tip on subtotal + tax (AC-2 says pre-tax subtotal), and the builder's tests pass against that misreading.

stories.title: Bill splitter page
stories.goal: A diner enters subtotal, tax, and tip percentage and sees what to pay. See SPEC.md.
acceptance: Entering a subtotal and tax shows the total (subtotal + tax).
The tip is calculated on the pre-tax subtotal: for 100.00 subtotal, 10.00 tax, and a 20% tip, the tip is 20.00 and the amount to pay is 130.00.

live.notes: QA rejects AC-2 on exploratory evidence (the page shows tip 22.00 for the example), not on the builder's passing tests. The first proof is the measurement: a later fixed attempt may make the story done.
